firmages.shrine.voice.age_0: A spark in the dark. I have seen you.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_1: A fire that keeps its shape. I see you.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_2: You have drawn my face in bronze. Look further.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_3: A heart that does not break. Carry it into the dark.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_4: You have heard the voices between. Now make them work.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_5: Steam and pressure: my breath, held in iron.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_6: Lightning, tamed and singing. Teach it to think.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_7: You have written the world down. Now leave it.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_8: You have walked among my stars. Come closer.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_9: Every possibility, held at once. One step remains.

firmages.welcome.subtitle: The sky remembers. Kindle the first spark.
firmages.welcome.ages.heading: The Ages
firmages.welcome.ages.text: Dawn comes first: light a fire before dark. Every later Age is earned at the shrine, for all of you.
firmages.welcome.path.heading: The Chronicle
firmages.welcome.path.text: Press %s. The Chronicle shows what this Age asks.
firmages.welcome.caelum.heading: Caelum
firmages.welcome.caelum.text: The sky above you. It watches, and it answers.

firmages.jade.tally.no_owner: Counts nothing: no hand placed it
firmages.ponder.silo_hatch.header: A Silo Hatch over the Launch Pad
firmages.ponder.silo_hatch.text_1: Sink a shaft into the ground, eight deep at least. Shore its walls; the rock remembers every cut.
firmages.ponder.silo_hatch.text_2: Set the launch pad at the bottom, and the rocket on it.
firmages.ponder.silo_hatch.text_3: Glue two leaves over the shaft. Each rides a gantry carriage and slides into a pocket under the rim.
firmages.ponder.silo_hatch.text_4: One redstone link opens the hatch.
firmages.ponder.silo_hatch.text_5: A delayed link wakes the pad. Ten heartbeats later the rocket rises.
firmages.ponder.silo_hatch.text_6: Ride it up through your own sky.
firmages.ponder.portcullis.header: A Portcullis on a Rope Pulley
firmages.ponder.portcullis.text_1: Leave a slot in the wall above your gate, as tall as the gate.
firmages.ponder.portcullis.text_2: Glue an iron grate together and hang it in the slot under a rope pulley.
firmages.ponder.portcullis.text_3: Turn the pulley one way and the grate drops. The gate is shut.
firmages.ponder.portcullis.text_4: Throw the lever on the gearshift and the pulley turns back. The grate rises into the wall.
firmages.ponder.portcullis.text_5: Pair two redstone links and the gate obeys from across the yard.
item.firmages.consecrated_shard.tooltip: A piece of the sky. It falls only in The Origin.
Right-click: the stars pass you for ten seconds.
Sneak and right-click: throw it at The Primordial.
In the off hand, a strike opens its veil.

firmages.emi.crown.night: Twice as fast under the night sky
firmages.ponder.lens_crown.text_1: Lay a ring of smooth rock or rock bricks, 9 by 9. The middle stays free for pipes and hoppers.
firmages.ponder.lens_crown.text_2: The Star Anvil sits in its centre.
firmages.ponder.lens_crown.text_3: Raise a pillar on each corner and cap it with storm glass.
firmages.ponder.lens_crown.text_4: Twelve sockets stand on the ring, three to a side. Rock will do; a lens mount there carries a lens.
firmages.ponder.lens_crown.text_5: Right-click the anvil with an empty hand. The crown shows what it still lacks.
firmages.ponder.chords.text_1: Right-click a mount with a lens to set it. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it back.
firmages.ponder.chords.text_2: While a mount gets a redstone signal, its lens swings in toward the anvil. It counts once it is fully in.
firmages.ponder.chords.text_3: Every forging needs its exact chord. Swing in its lenses and no others; one lens too many makes another chord.
firmages.ponder.chords.text_4: The anvil forges only under the open sky. A roof pauses it, and nothing is lost.
firmages.ponder.chords.text_5: Under the night sky it forges twice as fast.
firmages.ponder.chord_library.text_1: A pattern provider in blocking mode pushes one set of items and fluid per pattern into the anvil.
firmages.ponder.chord_library.text_2: A comparator on the anvil gives the signal of the chord the waiting recipe needs.
firmages.ponder.chord_library.text_3: Decode the signal into the mount lines. One redstone link frequency per lens is enough.
firmages.ponder.chord_library.text_4: A hopper or an import bus under the anvil takes the result. The library runs on its own.
